change_summary: Started Phase 1 and met the phase-1-entry milestone: the bounded first slice is implemented with linked reproducible evidence. The Phase 1 exit gate is not met and no independent review has been obtained.

evidence.description: Records the Phase 0 exit evidence and gate result.
Public foundation revision with the shared agent setup and reviewed control documents.
Task packet defining the bounded first slice, its risk class, and what is deliberately excluded.
Reproducible run of 149 tests against PostgreSQL 18.4, with the claims it does not support stated explicitly.
Source revision the slice evidence was produced from.

milestones.title: Authorize the executable financial kernel
acceptance_criteria: An explicitly authorized task advances Phase 1.
The task packet defines the bounded first slice and its risk class.
The Phase 1 evidence plan covers ledger invariants, recovery, security, and operations.

evidence.description: Authorized task packet: outcome, scope, out-of-scope, R3 risk class, affected invariants, assumptions, acceptance and failure cases, and the evidence plan.
Accepted decision record for the posting protocol and the independent database defences the slice relies on.
Executed evidence for the slice, including the defects found while producing it and the claims it does not support.

milestones.title: Meet the Phase 1 exit gate for the executable financial kernel
acceptance_criteria: Two independent qualified approvals are recorded for the protected ledger change.
Backup and point-in-time restore are followed by a full ledger reconciliation on a durably configured instance.
Crash-point and recovery evidence covers each step of the atomic posting boundary and outbox recovery.
A threat model and tailored ASVS tests exist for the slice.
Benchmark methodology and results are published without unqualified scale claims.
SBOM, provenance and signing draft, and operator runbooks beyond migration are produced.

transitions.summary: Phase 0 exit gate met after the foundation and shared agent control plane were validated and published.

evidence.description: Identifies the validated public foundation revision.

transitions.summary: Phase 1 started under an explicitly authorized task that bounds the work to the first vertical slice of the ledger kernel.

evidence.description: The authorizing task packet and its scope boundaries.

transitions.summary: Work began on the phase-1-entry milestone once the task packet and the governing decision records were written.

evidence.description: Money representation decision taken before the posting path was implemented.

transitions.summary: The bounded first slice is implemented and its evidence is reproducible: 149 tests against PostgreSQL 18.4 covering ledger invariants, database defences, tenant isolation and privilege separation, concurrency, delivery semantics, the HTTP contract, and a generative comparison against an independent reference model. Phase 1 exit is not claimed; independent review, durability, performance, supply-chain, and threat-model evidence remain outstanding.

evidence.description: Named reproducible evidence with tool versions, artifact digests, raw result, defects found, and an explicit statement of what it does not show.
Source revision the evidence was produced from.
